codeReview.summary: Verification-only feature — no application code changes. The commit (f666bc9) fixes 15 pre-existing test failures to match current UI patterns (skeleton spinners instead of text loading states, CSS-based pagination disabling, TruncateId rendering full text with CSS overflow, CardTitle as div not heading, Lucide SVG icon queries). All 6 VAL-CROSS assertions were systematically verified via Playwright browser automation against running services. 333/333 tests pass, typecheck clean, build successful.

issues.description: Testing CSS class 'pointer-events-none' couples tests to Tailwind implementation details. If Tailwind class names change or the disabling approach changes (e.g., back to `disabled` attribute), these tests break. Consider testing the observable behavior (click has no effect) instead of the CSS class. Non-blocking since the current approach is valid and consistent across all pagination tests.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker correctly skipped Phase 2 (write tests/implementation) for this verification feature, recognizing it was browser-testing only. sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker discovered that 404 console errors appear for relation type IDs being fetched as entity IDs (e.g., /api/entities/aabbccdd11223344556677889900aabb). The RelationsPanel component tries to resolve relation type as entity name but it's a property ID. This is documented as a pre-existing suggestion in the handoff's discoveredIssues but is not captured in .factory/library/ or AGENTS.md known quirks.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff.discoveredIssues[0]: '404 console error for relation type IDs being fetched as entity IDs'. user-testing.md Known Quirks mentions '404 console errors for stale relation references' but this is a different root cause (relation type ID vs entity ID).

summary: Cross-area validation (VAL-CROSS-001 through VAL-CROSS-006) fully verified via systematic Playwright browser testing. All six cross-area flows work correctly: create→edit name update, create→add relation visible on both entities, query invalidation propagating (entity count 85→89), back button consistency through history stack, polling cleanup on navigation (verified via network log — single poll request), and direct URL access to create/edit pages with proper error handling for invalid IDs. The commit also fixes 15 pre-existing test failures. No blocking issues found.
